name: beeper_off_flags.SYSTEM_INIT

verification.method: Exercised by the beeper bit-delta planner and mock-fc tests in a later M1 commit; observed on hardware only after the write gate and a bench unit exist.

licensing.note: Bit position and mask direction restated from a pinned source; no code, comments, tables or fixtures copied.

notes: BEEPER_GET_FLAG(mode) = (1 << (mode - 1)) at src/main/io/beeper.h line 25 (blob 38e6c8a8...). beeperMode_e (beeper.h lines 35-65): BEEPER_SILENCE=0 ... BEEPER_SYSTEM_INIT is the 18th enumerator (ordinal 17) -> bit index 16 -> mask 1<<16 = 0x00010000. Direction: a SET bit DISABLES the condition, a CLEAR bit ALLOWS it (src/main/io/beeper.c line 420 plays only when !(beeper_off_flags & flag)). Resolved commit 4adbd3ef7cb546947600e5f747bd5453c9573063 @ tag 4.5.5.
